explanation: Nonzero only at GO when the agent chooses a1 and the previous trial was rewarded: it is 10 (about 9-10) on the first rewarded trial after an unrewarded one, then falls by roughly 3 per trial while rewards keep coming (about 7, then 4-5, then 2-3, then 0). It is weaker later in the episode (at most 3-5 around trials 35-60, usually 0 after that) and 0 at every D1 and D2 step, after an unrewarded trial, and whenever the agent chooses a2.
